eventDetail.scope: ICAIRC 2026 will serve as a global platform for sharing innovations in artificial intelligence, robotics, and modern communications. As AI, robotic systems, and communication networks rapidly evolve, their integration has become a key driver of global technological and industrial progress. The conference will facilitate international academic-industry collaboration to advance cross-disciplinary integration across these three core fields. It will cover machine learning, NLP, mobile and medical robots, optical and wireless communications, and network security, with keynotes, technical sessions, and workshops to inspire innovation and cooperation. Attendees will access cutting-edge research, exchange ideas, and build global networks to foster practical applications and academic development. By uniting worldwide experts, ICAIRC 2026 will deepen cross-integration of AI, robotics, and communications, supporting the global progress of related industries and disciplines.
